metadata.description: FerionAI marketplace — engineering standards as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: ferion-engineering
plugins.description: An engineering standard as a plugin: guided setup, epic to issues, spec-driven flow, QA kit, safe release and blameless incident response, a pre-PR gate that leaves nothing for automated reviewers, constitution + Definition of Ready/Done, OWASP/WCAG/DORA, privacy, design system adoption, cost per task, MCP-first integrations and a health dashboard. The 6-step flow is enforced by hooks, not by prose.
